### `class DialogueRunner`

DialogueRunner — Executes a dialogue tree, manages state, and produces UI output.

| `checkInitiations` | `checkInitiations(playerPos, maxDist)` | Check if any NPC wants to initiate conversation. Call each tick. Returns the highest-urgency pending initiation, or null. |
